name: West Coast Paper Mills Limited
summary: West Coast Paper Mills Limited manufactures and sells pulp, paper, and paper boards in India and internationally. It operates through Paper, Cables, and Others segments. The company offers printing and writing paper, machine-glazed paper and boards, security and hi-value grades paper, cup stock and coated duplex boards, business stationery products, and premium printing paper under the WESCO brand, as well as optical fibers and optical fiber cables. It is also involved in the wind power generation business with a capacity of 74.8 megawatts.
